Requirement Statement: The system shall accept and execute commanded platform setpoints of -30 deg, 0 deg, and +30 deg relative to a calibrated zero reference.
Procedure / Test Setup: Issue each of the three setpoints from a host while the platform is armed; confirm that telemetry acknowledges and controller applies each setpoint.
Pass Criteria: All 3 distinct commands are accepted and used as the active target.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall maintain absolute angular-position error at or below 2.0 deg throughout the final 1.0 s of each 5.0 s, +30 deg or -30 deg commanded maneuver.
Procedure / Test Setup: Perform 10 +30 deg and 10 -30 deg maneuvers from calibrated 0 deg at rest; evaluate error over t=4.0-5.0 s, using a calibrated platform encoder checked against an independent angular reference.
Pass Criteria: For each of 20 trials, max absolute error in [4.0, 5.0] s <= 2.0 deg.
Evidence to Capture: time-series CSV; independent-reference calibration record; error plots
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall enter the +/-2.0 deg target-angle band by t=4.0 s and remain inside that band until t=5.0 s for a commanded +30 deg or -30 deg maneuver starting from rest.
Procedure / Test Setup: Use TEST-002 raw data; compute last entry to the +/-2 deg band, treating any later departure before 5.0 s as failure.
Pass Criteria: All 20 trials settle by 4.0 s and stay within the band through 5.0 s.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall limit angular overshoot to at most 5.0 deg beyond the target angle during a 5.0 s, +30 deg or -30 deg maneuver starting from rest.
Procedure / Test Setup: Use TEST-002 traces; determine peak excursion past each commanded setpoint in the commanded direction.
Pass Criteria: Overshoot <= 5.0 deg in all 20 trials.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall return from an initial platform orientation of +30 deg or -30 deg to a commanded 0 deg orientation with absolute error at or below 2.0 deg for the final 1.0 s of a 5.0 s maneuver.
Procedure / Test Setup: Start from a stable +/-30 deg orientation; command 0 deg; record 10 trials from each starting angle.
Pass Criteria: For each of 20 trials, max absolute error over t=4.0-5.0 s <= 2.0 deg.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The platform-angle sensing subsystem shall deliver valid, time-stamped angle measurements at an average rate of at least 100 Hz, with no gap between consecutive valid measurements exceeding 20 ms during a 5.0 s maneuver.
Procedure / Test Setup: Instrument sensor read timestamps during 10 maneuvers; compute sample rate and maximum intersample interval.
Pass Criteria: Each test >= 100 Hz average and <= 20 ms maximum gap.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The attitude-control task shall execute at an average rate of at least 200 Hz, with no interval between consecutive executions exceeding 10 ms during a 5.0 s maneuver.
Procedure / Test Setup: Instrument task execution using a GPIO toggle or monotonic MCU timestamps; run 10 maneuvers.
Pass Criteria: Each test >= 200 Hz average; all task intervals <= 10 ms.
Evidence to Capture: MCU timing logs or scope captures
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall record time-stamped target angle, measured platform angle, platform angular rate, wheel speed, control output, and fault state at an average logging rate of at least 100 Hz during a 5.0 s maneuver.
Procedure / Test Setup: Capture logs during 10 maneuvers; inspect field completeness, timestamps, logged rate, and loss against generated sequence numbers.
Pass Criteria: All 6 fields present; >= 100 Hz average; <= 1% missing records per trial.
Evidence to Capture: raw CSV; logging script; loss summary
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The controller shall constrain measured reaction-wheel speed magnitude to no more than 1200 RPM during standard, uninterrupted +/-30 deg and return-to-zero maneuvers.
Procedure / Test Setup: Use calibrated wheel encoder during TEST-002 and TEST-005; inspect absolute maximum over all maneuvers.
Pass Criteria: Maximum measured absolute speed <= 1200 RPM in all nominal trials.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The controller electronics shall operate without reset or loss of command reception for a DC input voltage between 10.8 V and 13.2 V during nominal maneuver operation.
Procedure / Test Setup: Run representative low-speed, enclosed maneuvers at 10.8 V, 12.0 V, and 13.2 V with a current-limited supply; record command reception and resets.
Pass Criteria: All maneuvers execute; zero MCU resets and zero missing commands at each voltage.
Evidence to Capture: power-supply settings; serial logs; oscilloscope traces
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The custom controller shall maintain its nominal 3.3 V logic supply between 3.135 V and 3.465 V during nominal maneuver operation at any qualified input voltage from 10.8 V to 13.2 V.
Procedure / Test Setup: Measure 3.3 V rail at input 10.8 V, 12.0 V, and 13.2 V with motor load using an oscilloscope or calibrated logger.
Pass Criteria: All recorded 3.3 V rail samples fall within [3.135, 3.465] V.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: Activating the hardware emergency-stop device shall interrupt the motor power feed within 100 ms independently of microcontroller firmware execution.
Procedure / Test Setup: With the flywheel secured and under guarded low-speed operation, instrument the e-stop contact and downstream motor power feed; activate the stop with normal firmware and with the MCU halted.
Pass Criteria: Feed interruption <= 100 ms in both cases; independent hardwired power path confirmed by inspection.
Evidence to Capture: schematic; contact timing trace; test log
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The controller shall disable motor drive no later than 150 ms after the last valid platform-angle sample when platform-angle data cease arriving.
Procedure / Test Setup: Inject a simulated encoder disconnect or stale-data stream at guarded low speed; measure time from last valid sample to disabled gate signal.
Pass Criteria: Motor-drive disable occurs within 150 ms in all 10 injections.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The controller shall disable motor drive within 100 ms after receiving a wheel-speed measurement with magnitude at or above 1500 RPM.
Procedure / Test Setup: Inject encoder-equivalent overspeed data into the controller at a safely stationary or low-speed rotor; measure gate-disable latency.
Pass Criteria: Motor-drive disable within 100 ms in each of 10 injections.
Evidence to Capture: injected-data trace; fault timestamp; gate waveform
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The assembled flywheel enclosure shall prevent a straight rigid 12 mm diameter probe from contacting the flywheel through any exterior opening when fully installed.
Procedure / Test Setup: With power disconnected, inspect all openings using a 12 mm diameter rigid probe; record enclosure closure and fastener configuration.
Pass Criteria: Probe cannot touch wheel at any exterior opening.
Evidence to Capture: inspection checklist; dimensioned enclosure drawing; photos
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The mechanical design package shall include a calculated or CAD-derived mass moment of inertia for the complete rotating platform about its pivot axis.
Procedure / Test Setup: Extract mass properties from CAD or compute composite-body inertia; document included components and the pivot axis.
Pass Criteria: A numerical J_platform in kg*m^2 is recorded with mass breakdown and calculation method.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The final integrated prototype shall use a project-designed four-layer printed circuit board for the microcontroller and motor-driver control functions rather than separate development boards.
Procedure / Test Setup: Review PCB stackup, fabrication outputs, assembled board, and demonstrate basic motor control using the project PCB with development boards disconnected.
Pass Criteria: Four copper layers verified; MCU and motor control operate on custom PCB.
Evidence to Capture: KiCad source; Gerbers; assembly photos; demonstration video
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The DC input current drawn by the integrated system shall not exceed 2.5 A during nominal +/-30 deg or return-to-zero maneuvers with a 12.0 V supply.
Procedure / Test Setup: Measure supply current with a suitably rated current probe or calibrated power instrument during 10 positive and 10 negative maneuvers plus return-to-zero.
Pass Criteria: Peak measured supply current <= 2.5 A in every trial.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The integrated system shall execute a 20-minute scripted sequence of alternating 0 deg, +30 deg, 0 deg, -30 deg setpoints without an uncommanded microcontroller reset.
Procedure / Test Setup: Run the timed sequence inside the approved guard; monitor the boot counter and log timestamps continuously.
Pass Criteria: Zero uncommanded resets during the full 20-minute sequence.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: After entry into a motor-drive fault state, the controller shall prevent motor re-enablement until a new explicit operator arm command is received.
Procedure / Test Setup: Induce a safe synthetic encoder fault or driver-fault condition; restore normal inputs without arming; then issue arm command.
Pass Criteria: Motor drive remains disabled before the arm command and only becomes eligible after an arm command.
Notes / Open Issues: Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall recover to within +/-2.0 deg of a 0 deg commanded hold angle within 4.0 s after release from a manually imposed +/-5.0 deg angular displacement at a platform angular rate of magnitude no greater than 5 deg/s.
Procedure / Test Setup: For each direction, displace platform by 5 deg while servo enabled; release near zero rate; log 5 valid trials.
Pass Criteria: All 10 trials recover within 4.0 s and remain within +/-2.0 deg for 1.0 s.
Notes / Open Issues: Stretch goal - optional. Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: The system shall support operator selection between a baseline PD controller and a second independently implemented state-feedback controller for the same commanded maneuver.
Procedure / Test Setup: Command identical 30 deg maneuvers using PD and state-feedback control; verify active mode flag and log both responses.
Pass Criteria: Both modes execute the maneuver and produce distinct labelled datasets; each passes SYS-002.
Notes / Open Issues: Stretch goal - optional. Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.

Requirement Statement: A fused platform angular-rate estimate shall achieve root-mean-square error at or below 5 deg/s relative to an encoder-derived reference over a scripted sequence of +/-30 deg maneuvers.
Procedure / Test Setup: Record synchronized IMU rate and calibrated encoder angle at >=100 Hz; compute fused estimate and reference velocity with a documented noise filter.
Pass Criteria: Rate RMSE <= 5 deg/s over the complete test interval.
Evidence to Capture: sensor-calibration data; analysis notebook; RMSE report
Notes / Open Issues: Stretch goal - optional. Threshold and method require feasibility review before baseline.
